{{Top|leg}}
'''All-axis thrusters''' were a type of [[Engine/Legends|engine]]. In conjunction with [[orbital adjustment jet]]s, all-axis thrusters were used to stabilize [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] such as [[Exis Station/Legends|Exis Station]] to keep its [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] steady.<ref name="Firestorm">{{JournalCite|15|Firestorm (short story)}}</ref>
